summary: Choose one of the four tracks: General CME, Data Science, Imaging Science, or Mathematical and Computational Finance. The audit checks the track's listed courses and unit counts, letter grades where the track asks for them, a C- or better in every letter-graded course, at least 36 letter-graded units and 45 units in all. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA, the advisor-approved electives, and for the distinction in research the thesis, symposium talk and 3.6 GPA.

VU8fbgDQ.why: Overview.
